notes: TBox, as geography-replace-0005: each well-known member's class membership and its stored form are separate background facts; a stored world gives up the membership and adds the wider, unedited class the record's summary moves it to (a firm rule giving the original form), a rule world gives up the stored form. The record's 'wider rule that the edited rule overrides for its class' is a default (specific beats general) and is not expressible, so it is left out here; the delete mirror encodes it with the class link that the delete cuts. Individuals are the pronoun slots; one individual per case form, with the record's sentences as surfaces.

object_form: I went to the cinema with hir
subject_form: I went to the cinema with ze
